title: Vegan Korean Cabbage Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with Korean chili flakes, velvety texture, and peppery notes, all in a vegan-friendly package.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the Korean chili flakes and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped cabbage and cook until it starts to wilt, about 5 minutes.
Pour in the vegan broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Season with soy sauce and serve hot.
